CMP indexed at $0575 searches this table with Y initialized to seven at $0410 and decremented through zero.
STA indexed at $0596 writes read bytes with Y=5 or Y=2; absolute reads consume $05F1..$05F5.
STY at $0271, LDY at $0274 and INC at $04C0 manage the track index.
STA at $00AB/$03AA and BIT/LDA at $0184/$048F/$0516 select disk-read mode.
Copied wipe-start-address field retains a zero initializer; the primary body stores its loop address here.
